name: Title detail
summary: A film or series page: a drawn backdrop with the title, year, age rating, seasons and score, then Resume and My list, the synopsis and cast, a season switch and episode rows with stills and progress.
use: on the detail page of a series, film, course or show
a11y: An article named by its title; the season switch is a native radio group, My list is a toggle button with aria-pressed, and each episode row is one button that says its number, title and time left.
